backup.title: Encrypted backup
backup.text: Save all your data in a .ccbackup file encrypted with a password only you know. Use it to move to another device or to recover your data if the browser deletes it.
backup.never: You haven't made a backup yet. We recommend making one now.
backup.overdue_one: Your last backup is from {{date}}, {{count}} day ago. It has been more than {{limit}} days: make a new backup.
backup.overdue_other: Your last backup is from {{date}}, {{count}} days ago. It has been more than {{limit}} days: make a new backup.
backup.unknownLast: The date of the last backup could not be read.

export.title: Export encrypted backup
export.description: Choose a password to encrypt the backup. You will need it to restore it.
export.noRecovery: If you forget the password there is no way to recover the data in the backup. Keep it in a password manager.
export.requirements: At least {{min}} characters. A long phrase with several words is best.
export.tooShort_one: The password must have at least {{min}} characters. Add {{count}} more.
export.tooShort_other: The password must have at least {{min}} characters. Add {{count}} more.
export.mismatch: The passwords don't match. Type it again exactly.

restore.heading: Restore a backup
restore.fileHint: Restoring replaces all the current data on this device.

confirm.title: Replace all your data?
confirm.description: Restoring “{{file}}” will delete all the current transactions, accounts, rules and budgets on this device and replace them with the ones in the backup. This can't be undone.

restore.title: Restore backup
restore.description: Enter the password used to encrypt “{{file}}”.
restore.passwordHint: If the password is wrong or the file is damaged, your current data stays unchanged.

storage.title: Storage
storage.unavailable: This browser can't estimate the space used.
storage.persistent: Persistent storage: the browser won't delete your data to free up space.
storage.notPersistent: Storage is not persistent: the browser could delete your data if it runs out of space. Make regular backups.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Everything is stored only on this device, in the browser's storage.
privacy.noServer: There are no servers, accounts or analytics: your statements and transactions never leave the device.
privacy.encryption: Backups are encrypted right here (256-bit AES-GCM with a key derived from your password) before they are downloaded.

rules.title: Rules and categories
rules.text: Manage the rules that categorise your transactions automatically, and your categories.

delete.title: Delete all data
delete.text: Removes all transactions, accounts, rules, budgets and imports from this device. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.
delete.description: Everything stored on this device will be deleted and this can't be undone. You can only get it back from a backup.
delete.done: All data on this device has been deleted.
